name: Fiona MacLeod
bio:
Fiona's career in motorsport began almost by accident. Originally studying materials science, a summer internship at a small racing team ignited a passion for the complex world of composite materials. She quickly realized that the precision and innovation demanded in racing perfectly aligned with her own meticulous nature. Over the years, Fiona has honed her skills in both fabrication and repair, becoming a go-to expert for complex composite structures.

Her pragmatic approach is legendary within the paddock. Fiona focuses on practical solutions and efficient workflows, always prioritizing performance and reliability. While fiercely independent and comfortable working alone, she values collaboration when tackling multifaceted challenges. Fiona brings a rare blend of technical expertise and a relentless drive for perfection, making her an invaluable asset to any team.

What sets Fiona apart is her ability to blend traditional techniques with cutting-edge materials. She is constantly experimenting and refining her methods, pushing the boundaries of what's possible with composites, and is always eager to learn more and pass on her knowledge.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Fiona has a lean build and a focused expression, with perpetually grease-stained hands.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a needle point before starting any project.
Has a peculiar fondness for collecting antique micrometers.
Mumbles quietly to herself while working on intricate repairs.
